Chapter 553 - 553 Punish; Awards (1)

Chapter 553 - 553 Punish; Awards (1)

553 Punish; Awards (1)

When Li Xinyue returned to Jiangbei University, it was already nine o’clock at night.

As soon as she walked into the dormitory, Wang Tong quickly came over and said with a smile, “Xinyue, you’re back…

“You must be thirsty, right? I just bought you a cup of milk tea.”

Obviously, Wang Tong was trying to ease the relationship between the two of them.

The strength that Lin Fan had displayed was simply too extraordinary.

“Drink it yourself,” Li Xinyue said indifferently. “I’m not thirsty.”

After saying that, she walked away and sat on her bed.

Wang Tong raised the milk tea and felt a little awkward.

She gritted her teeth and came to Li Xinyue again. “Xinyue, it was my fault earlier…

“At that time, I thought that you didn’t have a partner…

“After seeing Tan Jiayu… I thought he was a good person, so I wanted to introduce him to you.

“Since I wasn’t aware of the situation, can you not be angry? I’m sorry. Let’s still be good friends, okay?”

After Wang Tong finished speaking, she put on a pitiful look.

However, this made Li Xinyue even more annoyed.

She was not aware?

Did she not tell her that she already had someone she liked?

Of course, the most important thing was that Wang Tong had mocked Lin Fan!

This was something that Li Xinyue absolutely could not forgive!

“You and I have never been friends, let alone good friends!” Li Xinyue said coldly.

After she finished speaking, she no longer paid attention to Wang Tong.

…

Initially, Tan Jiayou had been worried about Liu Yuhang and Lin Fan.

However, not long after, he relaxed again.

Yes, the Liu family did have a lot of power.

Since Liu Yuhang was so respectful to Lin Fan, the other party was definitely not weak either.

However, what did this have to do with him?

At most, he would not do business with the Liu family and the Lin family in the future and earn less money.

Therefore, Tan Jiayou found a clubhouse and spent the afternoon relaxing.

At this moment, Tan Jiayou’s phone rang.

He looked at the caller ID and saw that it was his father, Tan Yongxing.

“Dad, why are you…”

However, before he could finish speaking, Tan Yongxing’s stern voice sounded from the phone.

“Tan Jiayou, what the hell did you do?!”

This angry shout stunned Tan Jiayou.

He stuttered, “I didn’t do anything…”

“Didn’t do anything?! Then why did Liu Pharmaceuticals, Sun Pharmaceuticals, Song Herbal Tea, the Duan family, the Zhang family, and Wanfu Group all issue a ban on our company?!

“I’m telling you, the goods in Waffle Corporation’s hands can’t be sold anymore. All the previous orders have been canceled… Even Waffle Corporation is under strict scrutiny!

“Waffle Corporation could go bankrupt at any time!

“Tell me, what did you do?!” Tan Yongxing roared.

Originally, Liu Yuhang wanted to punish Waffle Corporation alone.

However, after he went home to investigate, he found that Waffle Corporation had a certain amount of power.

In order to punish it as soon as possible, Liu Yuhang told the Future group chat about how Tan Jiaxing had offended Lin Fan.

Therefore, Liu Pharmaceuticals, Sun Pharmaceuticals, Song Herbal Tea, the Duan family, the Zhang family, Wanfu Group, and many other forces launched an attack on Waffle Corporation.

Any one of these forces had already far surpassed Waffle Corporation.

The combined attack of the six forces could be said to be overwhelming.

In just half a day, Waffle Corporation was already on the verge of collapse.

Tan Jiayou said in a panic, “I… I… I…”

“What the f*ck?! Quickly speak!” Tan Yongxing called out to his son.

“I just wanted to pursue the girlfriend of a man named Lin Fan today. I didn’t know his identity at first, but then… Liu Yuhang appeared. He called Lin Fan ‘Brother Lin Fan…'” Tan Jiayou stuttered.

“Bastard!” Tan Yongxing shouted angrily. “Immediately get your ass to the company!”

“Alright… Alright,” Tan Jiayou said.

Therefore, Tan Jiayou rushed to Waffle Corporation without stopping.

When he arrived at the chairman’s office, Tan Yongxing hung up the phone dejectedly. When he looked up and saw Tan Jiayou, he roared, “Unfilial son!”

He strode forward and kicked Tan Jiayou to the ground.

“The company that I’ve worked so hard for half my life has been destroyed by you just like that!”

As he spoke, Tan Yongxing punched and kicked Tan Jiayou again.

…

Lin Fan was completely oblivious to all of this.

For the rest of the day, he was at Coiling Dragon Villa and Jiangbei University as usual.

On this day, when Lin Fan walked into the office, it was abnormally noisy.

“Xia Bing, Xia Xue, you guys are amazing!”

“That’s amazing!”

“Congratulations, congratulations!”

Lin Fan smiled and asked, “What is it? Tell me so I can be happy.”

Liu Qianqian said, “Xia Bing and Xia Xue have been selected for the International Computer Creation Award!”

“Oh?” Lin Fan’s eyes lit up as he said sincerely, “Good job!”

On the one hand, he was happy that Xia Bing and Xia Xue had won the award.

On the other hand, he had never forgotten that his mission was to let his students win three international awards.

With this, the mission was completed by one-third!

After Xia Bing and Xia Xue heard Lin Fan’s praise, their faces instantly turned red like ripe tomatoes. They became extremely happy and excited.
